PF.43817/D.S.9.a.  SECRET.

G.P.O. - Captain Booth.

In confirmation of my telephone conversation this morning will you please add the following address to the check on Max Julius Alexander HODANN:-

24, Cockspur Street,
S.V.1.

Miss Sissmore.

27th March, 1935.
